Bengaluru Food Safety Raids Uncover Violations in Warehouses and Canteens

Food safety authorities in Bengaluru conducted surprise inspections across various establishments, leading to the sealing of a Zepto warehouse on August 11 due to unhygienic storage conditions, misbranding, and other violations. Inspections also revealed cockroaches in a legislators' hostel canteen and rats and droppings in an Indira Canteen kitchen warehouse. Expired food items were seized from Apollo Hospital's canteen. These actions followed a broader trend of food safety checks in the city, impacting multiple quick-commerce and food service facilities.
